'''Jeremy Forbes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th–9th at [[March 2002 Austin tournament]] on 23 March 2002, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3535">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-25-austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarmd3535/ austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarm], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 25 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-25-austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarmd3535/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
